To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the use of object-oriented techniques and the delegation of control to objects that are specialized for the task at hand, allows for the creation of a system that is extensible, flexible, and easy to use.

1) a variety of control methods can be used to animate objects, 2) objects can change all of their characteristics dynamically and 3) a variety of performance techniques can be used to achieve interactive performance.

the integration of interactive techniques for modeling and animating objects that change in appearance and behaviour over time can be facilitated by using an object-oriented framework that allows objects to dynamically change their attributes and by exploiting inter- and intraframe coherency.
In summary, our research is concerned with
providing a framework for the integration and evaluation of interactive animation techniques.
developing a framework for the integration, testing, and comparison of a variety of interactive animation techniques.
the design of an extensible system for modeling and animating dynamic objects.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
we have developed a system that is extensible, interactive, flexible, and efficient.

the system is an interactive modeling and animating system that facilitates the modeling of diverse dynamic objects and the integration of a wide range of interactive animation techniques, including scripted, gesture and behavioral control.
the object-oriented paradigm provides a powerful and flexible framework in which to integrate interactive animation techniques.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we present a framework for the integration and interaction of various animation techniques.
the system is a framework for the integration and interaction of various simulation and animation paradigma.

we are trying to develop an interactive modeling and simulation environment that is as flexible and powerful as the best animation packages, but which is also capable of supporting interactive animation.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the integration of animation techniques is a complex problem that requires a careful design of the underlying data structures and the animation system's architecture.
a framework for the integration and interactivity of diverse animation techniques can be implemented efficiently.
it is possible to create an extensible framework that supports a variety of interactive animation techniques and that can be used to study the integration of such techniques.
